description: Eight native-eight-second floor-action migrations. All source, physical and visual review remain pending; source timing and solver anchors are preserved. Independent GPU4080 metadata revision: raw source-file SHA for renderer checks; recorded LF SHA retained; original motion and files unchanged.
reviewPolicy: External actual visual review bound to source and preview manifest/index/PNG SHA is required before full production. No automatic review approval.

phase.countingSemantics: One simultaneous lift and lowering of both straight legs counts as one rep; the 8-second source contains two bilateral reps. Preserve default 8 reps per set, not eight per leg. The source holds 1.4 seconds at each peak, not a prescribed extra hold outside the demonstrated rhythm.

risks: Supporting floor hands retain original locks and reach177; inspect actual visible finger minY, palm pins and elbows >=176 without replacing floor with free hands.
Inspect both knees >=176, heel lift/readability, pelvis/mat and hand/shin clearance; original source corrected hands outside the shins.
Legacy quadRect highlight panel may require explicit new-pipeline support/occlusion verification; no automatic highlight acceptance.

phase.countingSemantics: One rear-foot/shin lift and controlled lowering counts as one rep. The left rear knee stays on the mat and the right leg is in front. The 8-second clip has two left-hip reps and no switch. Preserve default 8; proposed per-side interpretation (four loops before changing) requires editorial approval because legacy dose does not explicitly identify per-side versus total. Opposite-side media is not produced.

side.note: Left foot/shin lifts via rear-hip internal rotation while left knee stays supported; right leg remains in front. Optional boundary after completed per-side dose, not an in-clip or every-loop mandatory switch.

risks: The selected r2 depends on _9090-feet.mjs and hard-coded old-rig REST/knee geometry; inspect new knee location, foot orientation and contact through lift. Do not silently revise the shared module.
Inspect hand/finger-to-knee contact and near-floor toe/shin clearance; keep the rear knee supported, not lifting as the old voice incorrectly instructed.

phase.countingSemantics: One simultaneous opening and closing of both knees counts as one rep. The 8-second demonstration contains two bilateral reps; default 10 means ten opening-closing reps in total, not ten per knee or a static hold.

risks: Inspect both relaxed palms/fingers near y27mm, head/shoulder/pelvis contact and soles together throughout; source pins=[] does not prove no sliding.

phase.countingSemantics: One gentle exhale-led hug and inhale-led easing counts as one breath rep. The 8-second source demonstrates two bilateral breath reps. Default reps=6 means six total breaths, not six per leg or a forced 6-second hold; breathing should remain comfortable.

risks: Inspect repaired hand-to-own-shin contact, fingers across the midline and actual maximum hip flexion on the new mesh; old r2 thresholds do not award new source QA.
Inspect head/shoulder support and deliberate pelvic curl; do not require the pelvis to remain pinned throughout.
